You are a hosted-E2E operator on freytag-forge. Your working directory is the real repository /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge. This task runs WITHOUT a sandbox and spends real money (Cloudflare neurons), so read the hard rules first.

HARD RULES. Change nothing except: files under artifacts/e2e-* and frontend/test-results/ (generated, gitignored) and the output directory /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/bench/results/staged-de04ad8e/ . Do not edit or create any tracked file. No git add/commit/checkout/stash/reset/clean/push. Never print, echo, copy or upload .env or any token; `source .env` only inside the commands below. Staging only: if the API reports any channel other than staging, or a runtime other than scene-v1, stop and report. Run the billed test AT MOST ONCE in this task and never retry; a failed or aborted run is data. Do not run anything else billed. Do not edit code to make a run pass.

WHAT THIS IS: a staged regression check of main de04ad8ea6348dc7c3628ff8d42baea898a620f6 after the worldkeeper boundary-move refactor (PR #735), which changed runtime code. The last staged pass was on 21377382.

STEPS, in order:
1. Identity: `mkdir -p bench/results/staged-de04ad8e/spine && source .env && curl -s "$E2E_API_BASE_URL/api/v1/version" > bench/results/staged-de04ad8e/spine/identity.json`. Expected sha de04ad8ea6348dc7c3628ff8d42baea898a620f6 (if different, record it and stop without running the test).
2. Delete stale artifacts: `rm -f artifacts/e2e-spine.json artifacts/e2e-spine.md`.
3. Run `source .env && cd frontend && E2E_TURN_TIMEOUT_MS=90000 npm run test:e2e -- --grep @spine` with a command timeout of at least 50 minutes. A nonzero exit is data, not an error to fix.
4. Copy artifacts/e2e-spine.json and .md (those that exist) into bench/results/staged-de04ad8e/spine/. If the run failed, write the verbatim failure text (secrets stripped, tail of the command output) to bench/results/staged-de04ad8e/spine/run-failure.txt.
5. Write bench/results/staged-de04ad8e/spine/operator-note.md (at least 200 characters, strictly factual): sha, channel, runtime; pass or fail; turns played; scenes reached; story_complete; earned exits; chain misses; committed reveals for scene 1C (expected k_sl_1c_a_r1, k_sl_1c_b_r1, k_sl_1c_c_copy_numbers) and 2C; counts of fallback, guard-retry, recovery and missed turns; latency median and max; for a failure, the verbatim failing assertion or infrastructure error (a 404 'session does not exist' or HTTP 503 is infrastructure; say so). Do not interpret beyond the evidence.
tasks.verified: staging identity recorded, fresh spine report or verbatim failure, no tracked source changed
